title: Wire break on a 4-20 mA input
summary: The loop current is 0 mA: the analog input reports wire break and the value is invalid.

sections.heading: Summary
sections.body: The loop current is 0 mA: the analog input reports wire break and the value is invalid.

troubleshooting.effect: Invalid measurement; dependent control must react safely
symptoms: Value jumps to an overflow or invalid code
Wire-break entry in the diagnostic buffer
diagnosticMethod: Check terminals, junction boxes and the transmitter supply
repair: Repair the wiring or replace the transmitter
Verify the value returns and the diagnostic goes outgoing
troubleshooting.explanation: A live-zero signal makes a broken loop detectable: below about 3.6 mA the value cannot be a real measurement.
